# ilikefish.space

> ilikefish.space is a free, account-free browser game arcade. It hosts small HTML5 games that can be played instantly, many of which work offline after the site is loaded. The site is operated by fishesarethings; its own code and text are released under the Unlicense, while games and bundled assets remain with their respective authors.

Canonical site: https://ilikefish.space/
Contact: https://ilikefish.space/contact.html · https://github.com/fishesarethings/ilikefish.space/issues
Last updated: 2026-10-25

## What the site offers

- 18 small browser games across arcade, puzzle, idle/tycoon, strategy, educational and casual categories.
- No sign-up, download or purchase is required to play.
- The site is a progressive web app with offline support for cached pages.
- Game progress and preferences are stored locally in the browser. The two games with optional online features (Aqua Odyssey and Idle Shop Keeper) send an anonymous Firebase ID, a chosen display name and game data to Google Firebase; see the privacy policy.
- A local-only recommendation system ranks games from the visitor’s play history; no play history is sent to a server.
- Advertising is provided by Google AdSense. Ads are labelled and kept outside the game area.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ilikefish.space/): featured and recommended games, all games, game-maker link.
- [All games](https://ilikefish.space/games/): the complete playable catalogue.
- [Game player](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html): the shared player wrapper; use ?folder=<folder> to open a game.
- [Game Maker](https://ilikefish.space/gamepack/): build and export a small game package.
- [About](https://ilikefish.space/about.html): who runs the site and how it works.
- [Contact](https://ilikefish.space/contact.html): questions, bugs, submissions and removal requests.
- [Privacy](https://ilikefish.space/privacy.html) and [Terms](https://ilikefish.space/terms.html).

## Games

- [Pong](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=pong): Pong is a free browser version of the arcade classic: rally the ball, angle your shots and beat the computer paddle. Works on desktop and mobile. Tags: arcade, sports, tennis, 2-player, local-multiplayer, retro, fast, skill, keyboard, gamepad.
- [Times Table Balloons](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=timestable-balloons): Times Table Balloons is a free maths game for practising multiplication: answer the questions to pop balloons before they sink. Works on phone and desktop. Tags: educational, math, arcade, timed, quick-play, high-score, touch.
- [Why on Earth Is the Chicken Crossing the Road](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=why-chicken-crossed): Why on Earth Is the Chicken Crossing the Road is a free browser puzzle game: guide the chicken across busy roads, dodge traffic and swing a hammer. Tags: arcade, action, maze, runner, timing, challenge, fast, touch, high-score.
- [Tetnis](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=tetnis): Tetnis is a free block-stacking puzzle with sharp iron pieces. Clear lines, chase combos and keep the stack from reaching the top. Tags: puzzle, blocks, tetromino, arcade, retro, high-score, challenge, skill, touch.
- [Lawn Mower Simulator](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=lawnmower-simulator): Lawn Mower Simulator is a free, relaxing browser game: drive a mower around, cut every patch of grass and earn coins for a tidy lawn. Tags: simulator, chill, tycoon, open-ended, collect, upgrade, casual, keyboard, touch.
- [Block Bang](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=Block-bang): Block Bang is a free browser matching game with a glitchy arcade feel: line up blocks, trigger explosions and clear the board in quick bursts. Tags: puzzle, blocks, match, arcade, fast, challenge, casual, touch.
- [Dice Roll Idle Empires](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=DiceRollIdleEmpires): Dice Roll Idle Empires is a free idle game: roll the dice, earn whatever you land on and reinvest your winnings into a growing empire. Tags: idle, tycoon, dice, numbers, incremental, progression, chill, shop, upgrade, touch.
- [Gridbite](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=gridbite): Fast-paced local 1-2 player snake-like game on a 16×16 grid (adding up to 256 squares!). Supports keyboard (WASD + Arrow keys), gamepad, and touch controls (on-screen buttons). Tags: arcade, snake, grid, 2-player, local-multiplayer, fast, challenge, skill, keyboard, gamepad, touch, boost.
- [Rotaze](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=rotaze): Difficult but fun rotating maze game. Fun and a good challenge! Tags: puzzle, maze, rotation, challenge, skill, timer, coins, shop, touch, casual.
- [Tower Defense](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=Tower-Defense): Tower Defense is a free browser strategy game: place towers along the path, upgrade them and stop every wave of enemies before they break through. Tags: strategy, tower-defense, action, fantasy, waves, enemies, upgrade, challenge, touch, keyboard.
- [Dice Roll Idle Empires 2](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=DiceRollIdleEmpires2): Dice Roll Idle Empires 2 is the free sequel to the browser idle game: roll the dice, grow faster and unlock a deeper set of upgrades and milestones. Tags: idle, tycoon, dice, numbers, incremental, progression, chill, sequel, shop, upgrade.
- [Fish Climb Racing](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=fishclimbracing): Fish Climb Racing is a free physics game: swim upstream against the current, keep your momentum and push for a new distance record. Tags: racing, action, fish, arcade, endless, coins, shop, fast, skill, touch.
- [Mine Tycoon](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=minetycoon): Mine Tycoon is a free idle mining game: dig for ore, buy better equipment and build a mining operation that keeps earning while you are away. Tags: idle, tycoon, mining, clicker, incremental, progression, shop, upgrade, chill, touch.
- [Emoji Match](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=emojimatch): Emoji Match is a free browser quiz game: read the topic and pick the emoji that fits. Quick rounds for phone or desktop. Tags: puzzle, memory, educational, match, timer, chill, touch.
- [Fishy Clicker I](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=fishyclicker): Fishy Clicker I is a free idle clicker game: tap the fish to earn points, then buy upgrades that earn for you while you are away. Tags: clicker, idle, fish, incremental, chill, casual, touch.
- [Fishcore: Data Dive](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=fishcore): Fishcore: Data Dive is a free browser arcade game: steer the fish through a data-filled world, grab what you can and push as far as your reflexes allow. Tags: action, fish, arcade, fast, skill, challenge, enemies, upgrade, touch.
- [Fish Tycoon](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=fishtycoon): Fish Tycoon is a free fishing idle game: catch fish, sell the catch and reinvest in better gear to grow a fishing business. Tags: tycoon, idle, fish, management, progression, shop, upgrade, chill, casual, touch.
- [Fish Battle I](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=battlefishi): Fish Battle I is a free browser arena game: fight other fish, dodge incoming attacks and try to be the last one swimming. Tags: action, fish, arcade, enemies, levels, fast, challenge, touch.

## Technical notes

- Pages are static HTML/CSS/JavaScript hosted on GitHub Pages and delivered through Cloudflare.
- The player wraps each game in an iframe; games are plain HTML5/JS and do not require a plugin.
- `/llms-full.txt` contains a longer machine-readable catalogue with controls and feature notes.
- The site does not require login and does not expose private user data.
